name: ci-smoke
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        shard-index: [0, 1]
    steps:
      - run: pytest -q --shard-id=${{ matrix.shard-index }} --num-shards=3
